image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a custom automotive wheel attached to a red vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a brushed silver finish on the face and a glossy red interior barrel. The center cap displays a yellow shield logo with a black prancing horse (resembling Ferrari). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread blocks and sidewall texture. The brake caliper and rotor are partially visible through the spokes.
